Premise: corrected 2026-10-26T14:58Z — on `origin/main` `83a26c38d0`:
- The proxy answers 502 `MARKETPLACE_PROXY_FAILED` only when its own fetch throws (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-proxy-plugin.ts:355-367`); upstream answers pass through with their own status.
- `marketplaceApi.ts:219-226` already sets `err.code`.
- `MarketplacePage.tsx:171-178 toLoadFailure` never reads `code`, and `:720-723` picks `answeredError` for any status. A proxy 502 therefore reads "the catalog returned an error (HTTP 502)", and `:726` prints the raw "fetch failed" in full view.
- The card's literal copy, which names the host, needs a new server wire field and new pack keys. It is out of this claim and becomes a follow-up if wanted.
Serial constraints cleared: none. No open claim holds `MarketplacePage.tsx`. Open PR #26123 edits other regions of the same file (import, a hook, `installLocal`), so rebase if it lands first.
Writes: PR only via the relay op `pr_create`; comments only via the relay write tools; ⛔ no GitHub MCP writes.

- **Ruling section:** triage 6407161741 says "the 502 relay's code should drive the copy".
- **Seat's route:**
  - Carry `code` on `LoadFailure`. Treat `code === 'MARKETPLACE_PROXY_FAILED'` (and no status) as the unreachable class, with the line `marketplace.load.unreachable`. For that class only, put the raw cause behind a More/Less disclosure that reuses `refusalDetails.more/less/copy`.
  - Answered refusals (403, and a 502/503/504 relayed from upstream) keep `answeredError` and their visible server text (objectui#11688).
  - The online/same-origin hint logic is unchanged (the `sameOriginHint-11726` test stays green).
  - Tests: flip the 11688 proxy-502 case (unreachable line, then open the disclosure, then 'fetch failed'), and add a 503 control and a 403 control.
  - `Fixes #25891`.
